assign.title: Persistence & sync: build or buy
assign.question: Should Lew42 keep building its own save, sync and streaming layer (Item, List, Page, JSONL deltas, the socket), or adopt existing tools?
assign.conclusion: Keep the Item / List / Page core and fix it; borrow the protocols Figma, Linear and tldraw use; adopt libraries only at the edges. Read readme.md here.
